items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I was Gibral. I was Gibral. I was playing Clannett.

ctx.x: I was doing that. I was playing Clannett. Clannett, yeah. I was Gibral. I was Gibral. I was playing Clannett. That's right. You had Joe Pye playing alto. That's right. You're all right now. You take, uh, woman George Sims, he got out. That's where, uh, uh, Clay Dash come in there. Clay Dash come in there playing baritone. You take, uh, and Buddy Dash, he come in there playing trombone. I mean, uh, trumpet. They were two brothers. Buddy and Clay. Dash. Was that last name?
